study: Warehouse world-model optimisation with charged sensing and inference
model_features: past six scans, fleet memory, actual effective report count, known geometry, AP-local cross-band pooling and planned route
distillation_teacher: Frozen three-member supervised hybrid from the prior study
packet_objective: Mean-field and route-change errors, AP ranking and differentiable ns-3 MCS0 failure surrogate; not labelled as native packet-loss supervision
runtime_optimisations: BLAS covariance projection for every RadioMap reference
single-member candidates versus frozen three-member teacher
model_choice: Single checkpoint chosen by validation score within each three-seed family; no test seed ranking
selection_objective: Equal-condition smoothed native miss-count ratio to optimised RadioMap/native planner; choose family and planner on eight selection sites only
runtime_delay: Queue measured forecast/refit service times on a single FIFO worker. Planner sees a forecast only after ready time; interpolate its remaining horizons to its actual age. Fast control loop continues while waiting.
timing_free_ablation: On the eight primary sites, replay the selected new method and RadioMap without forecast delays and with the former 30-second background scan period
success: Report paired-site differences versus optimised RadioMap, previous JEPA and confirmed hybrid; intervals crossing zero fail control-superiority claims. Report compute, forecast-delta error, drift, scan cost and every negative result.
